messages:
maria: Deploybot flagged canary latency p95 up ~35% for embeddings route US-W
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Canary alert: p95 latency ↑ 35% vs baseline, error rate +0.2%. Suggested action: hold rollout and rollback to v3.1.2. Reason: kvcache mismatch on new kernel.
jake: I'm oncall, looking now. can you drop the grafana link?
maria: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/embeds-canary/6465432100 — spike starts ~11:22 UTC on a 5% traffic slice.
sam: +1 looking at runtime logs, seeing a cluster of compilation failures on t4-quant nodes around the same time.
leo: any risk to Dedicated tenants if we rollback the model binary? schema change or incompatibilites?
jen: good q. A full rollback could affect a small set of reserved pools if they pinned to the new build. prefer targeted route pin if possible. also we'll need release-note copy updated for the potential flip.
maria: deploy-bot is recommending immediate rollback, but jake requested a human tie-break to run quick probes first.
jake: propose human-in-the-loop: pause automated rollback for 12m, run smoke + kv-warmup checks and tail errors. If failures persist -> rollback. agree?
leo: ack. i'll run kv cache verification and post findings.
sam: running `kubectl logs -l surface=embeds-canary --since=10m | grep -i kvcache` now to surface misses.
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] rollback scheduled in 12m unless cancelled by operator via `/deploy cancel-rollback 6465432100`.
maria: noted. i'll update the release-notes draft to include an FYI about a short rollback window if we flip.
leo: kv cache warmup looks okay — miss rate ~0.1% in the sample. compilation error patterns point at the new kernel selection on t4 nodes.
jake: decision criteria: if compilation error count > 50 in the 12m window -> execute rollback. otherwise attempt targeted pin of embeddings to v3.1.1 on canary. jen, can you prep comms and the two command snippets?
jen: prepping. rollback command: `rbctl rollback v3.1.3 --target canary --notify ops`. pin command: `routectl set-model-route embeddings v3.1.1 --scope canary`. Drafting short slack + customer blurb.
maria: timeline: waiting for the 12m probe to finish, i'll post final by 11:40 UTC.
deploy-bot: [UPDATE] rollback auto-timer paused by operator jake. human decision pending.
jake: i'll give it 2 more minutes, then pin or rollback based on error tail.
leo: after pin/rollback, we'll monitor p95, error rate, and requests/sec for 30m before deciding rollforward.
jen: comms ready to send if we rollback. will coordinate customer-facing note.
maria: happy to run `routectl` if you want me to execute the pin.
sam: logs aggregated: 64 compilation errors in the last 10m -> hits our >50 threshold.
jake: executing rollback now: `rbctl rollback v3.1.3 --target canary`.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollback initiated by jake. Notifying on-call and posting to #eng-oncall.
maria: confirmed canary reverted to v3.1.2, p95 trending down in the first 2 minutes. will keep monitoring; close thread once stable. :thumbsup:
